## CONSUMED_UPLOAD_RETENTION_MS variable

How long the bytes of a consumed upload are kept when the consuming call never releases them: 15 minutes from consumption.

**Signature:**

```typescript
CONSUMED_UPLOAD_RETENTION_MS: number
```

## Remarks

The consuming call releases the bytes as soon as it finishes, on success or failure. This bound only applies when that never happens (the process ended mid-call). It outlasts any operation's time budget, so the sweep never deletes bytes an operation is still reading.
